title: Petrov's Defense: Three Knights Game
line: White guards the center pawn with a knight. Black pins that knight and wins the pawn back.

steps.text: Petrov's Defense, and White guards its pawn on e4 with a knight. Your pawn on e5 is still attacked.
Pin the knight that guards e4: bring your bishop out to b4.

also.b8c6: Guarding your pawn leads to the Four Knights Game. This lesson pins the knight.

steps.after: White takes your pawn. Now go after its pawn.

steps.text: Castle. Your rook gets ready to come to the file of the pawn on e4.
Bring the rook to e8. It aims down the file at the knight and the pawn behind it.

also.b4c3: Taking the knight at once is also played. This lesson brings the rook first.

steps.after: The knight steps back and attacks your bishop.

steps.text: Take the knight on c3, the guard of the pawn on e4.
Now take the pawn on e4. Its guard is gone, and material is level.

also.e8e4: The rook can take it too. This lesson takes with the knight.

steps.after: Your knight stands in the center. White has the two bishops, and you have a sound, active game.

summary: When a knight guards the attacked pawn, pin it or take it. Then the pawn falls.
